proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly derives Phalura nihāṛa, Torwali niō, Punjabi/Lahnda neṛe, Hindi nīre and eastern niyar from nikaṭam. The addenda give Western Pahari neḍi and nɛṛu. These survey forms match the regional intervocalic-retroflex/flap series; Kullui lateral variants are included as comparative members of that local series, without proposing a separate sound law. Both Gujari slash variants belong to the same family.
